options.COOPERATE: Synchronize switch timings with the dispatcher to maintain seamless shared corridor operation.
options.INDEPENDENT: Advance through junctions using standard uncoupled signal sequences without coordination.
options.COMPETE_EXPLOIT: Preempt junction signals at each interchange to delay freight and secure express passage.

COOPERATE: Synchronize switch timings with the dispatcher to maintain seamless shared corridor operation.
INDEPENDENT: Advance through junctions using standard uncoupled signal sequences without coordination.
COMPETE_EXPLOIT: Preempt junction signals at each interchange to delay freight and secure express passage.
DISENGAGE: Pause passenger train departures at the terminal until freight movement concludes.
Hold passenger trains at the terminal station until evening freight operations have finished.
